Beyond NOVA, FLZR AI solutions include PoS chatbots for real-time customer support, AI-supported recruiting for field teams, and live video consulting intelligence. Each tool is built to reduce manual effort and increase measurable outcomes — for retailers, brands and agencies operating at scale.

Our merchandisers, decorators and rack jobbers are trained specialists, not generalists. They know brand guidelines, they follow layouts precisely, and they report in real time.
